title: Cosmic Coincidence
hook: You see the Sun and Moon as the same size
script: You see the Sun and Moon as the same size But what if the Moon were closer The Sun is about 400 times wider than the Moon The Sun is also about 400 times farther away This is why we get perfect eclipses But that's not even the strange part The Moon drifts about 3.8 centimeters farther away every year In a few hundred million years, total eclipses will vanish from the sky forever You could watch human civilization rise and fall 80,000 times over before that happens Your view of the Sun and Moon will change forever

scenes.voiceover: You see the Sun and Moon as the same size
But what if the Moon were closer
The Sun is about 400 times wider than the Moon
The Sun is also about 400 times farther away
This is why we get perfect eclipses
But that's not even the strange part
The Moon drifts about 3.8 centimeters farther away every year
In a few hundred million years, total eclipses will vanish from the sky forever
You could watch human civilization rise and fall 80,000 times over before that happens
Your view of the Sun and Moon will change forever
